name: edit-check
description: After Claude edits files, runs the project's own check command in the background and hands Claude the new errors at its next request

command.title: Check command
command.description: The command to run after edits, through the shell, in the session's folder: say npx tsc --noEmit -p . or ruff check . Empty: the mod is off.

globs.title: Files it applies to
globs.description: Globs of the edited files that start a check, separated by commas, relative to the session's folder: say **/*.ts,**/*.tsx. A glob without a slash matches the file name anywhere. Empty: every file.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: A check still running after this long is stopped and its result dropped. 1 to 600.

maxChars.title: Max characters of output
maxChars.description: What Claude is handed of the errors is cut to this many characters. 200 to 50000.
